settings.name: Brightwater Sports Center
settings.tagline: Swim, climb, play and move. Classes for every age, under one roof in Marlow Heights.
settings.passNote: Open swim, the climbing hall, open courts and the fitness floor for one day. Classes are booked separately.
settings.waiver: I understand that sports and fitness activities carry a risk of injury. I confirm the participant is fit to take part, will follow the instructor's directions and the center's safety rules, and I accept responsibility for that risk. I allow the center to give first aid and call emergency services if needed.

sports.name: Swimming
sports.blurb: Lessons from first splashes to masters lanes, in a 25 m lap pool and a warm teaching pool.
sports.text:
Our eight-lane, 25 m pool and the warm teaching pool next to it host lessons for every age. Children learn in small groups with a coach in the water; teens and adults work on strokes, turns and fitness.

Every swim class keeps small ratios, and lifeguards are on deck whenever the pool is open.

sports.name: Basketball
sports.blurb: Skills, drills and friendly games on two full-size hardwood courts.
sports.text: Two full-size courts with glass backboards and bleacher seating. Junior classes build footwork, passing and shooting; teen and adult groups play structured scrimmages and league nights.

sports.name: Tennis
sports.blurb: Four outdoor hard courts and an indoor hall, with racket loans for beginners.
sports.text: Learn the strokes on our four outdoor hard courts or in the indoor hall when the weather turns. Beginner classes include racket loans and plenty of balls.

sports.name: Climbing
sports.blurb: A bouldering cave and 14 m rope walls, with routes reset every month.
sports.text: The climbing hall has a bouldering cave over deep mats and 14 m walls for top-rope and lead climbing. Our routesetters reset a section every month, so there is always something new.

sports.name: Yoga
sports.blurb: Calm, strong and bright: flow, recovery and yoga for athletes in Studio A.
sports.text: Studio A has a sprung wood floor, big windows and everything you need: mats, blocks and straps. Classes range from early-morning flow to slow recovery sessions for runners and climbers.

sports.name: Martial Arts
sports.blurb: Karate, judo and self-defense on 200 square meters of tatami.
sports.text: Our dojo has a full tatami floor and heavy bags. Children start with Little Dragons; teens and adults train karate and judo toward their next belt, or join a one-off self-defense workshop.

sports.name: Dance
sports.blurb: Ballet, hip-hop and social dance in a mirrored studio with a sprung floor.
sports.text: Studio B is a mirrored dance studio with barres and a sprung floor. Find ballet basics for young dancers, hip-hop for teens and salsa nights for adults.

sports.name: Gymnastics
sports.blurb: Beams, bars, rings and a foam pit for tumblers from age three.
sports.text: The gym hall has a sprung floor, low and high beams, bars, rings and a foam pit. Our coaches teach safe landings first, then the fun stuff.

instructors.name: Maya Chen
instructors.title: Head swim coach
instructors.bio: Maya swam distance freestyle at college and has coached at Brightwater since the pool opened. She loves the moment a nervous swimmer floats on their own for the first time.

instructors.name: Leo Martins
instructors.title: Basketball coach
instructors.bio: Leo played semi-pro for six seasons. He runs the junior and teen basketball programs and the Friday pickup league.

instructors.name: Ana Ruiz
instructors.title: Tennis pro
instructors.bio: Ana grew up on clay courts and now teaches players from age six to sixty. Her cardio tennis class is the loudest hour of the week.

instructors.name: Jordan Blake
instructors.title: Climbing lead
instructors.bio: Jordan sets routes, trains the youth climbing team and makes sure every new climber learns to belay safely.

instructors.name: Sofia Novak
instructors.title: Yoga teacher
instructors.bio: Sofia teaches flow and recovery yoga. Many of her students are runners, swimmers and climbers who wanted to move better.

instructors.name: Kenji Arai
instructors.title: Martial arts head coach
instructors.bio: Kenji has taught martial arts for over twenty years. He is patient with beginners and strict about respect on the mat.

instructors.name: Priya Das
instructors.title: Dance director
instructors.bio: Priya trained in classical ballet and street dance. She choreographs the end-of-season showcase every spring.

instructors.name: Marcus Hale
instructors.title: Gymnastics coach
instructors.bio: Marcus coaches the youngest tumblers and the parkour group, and helps out in the teaching pool on weekends.

classes.title: Learn to Swim: Splash
classes.text: Water confidence for little ones: blowing bubbles, floating, kicking and getting in and out safely. A coach is in the water with every group.
classes.bring: Swimsuit, towel, goggles if they like them.

classes.title: Stroke Clinic for Teens
classes.text: Freestyle, backstroke and breaststroke technique with video feedback, plus flip turns and starts. Swimmers should already swim 50 m without stopping.
classes.bring: Swimsuit, goggles, swim cap, water bottle.

classes.title: Adult Learn-to-Swim
classes.text: It is never too late. A calm, small group for adults who never learned or want to start over, in warm, shallow water.

classes.title: Masters Swim: Early Lanes
classes.text: Coached workouts for fit adult swimmers: intervals, pacing and race skills before work.
classes.bring: Swimsuit, goggles, cap, pull buoy if you have one.

classes.title: Summer Stroke Camp
classes.text: Two weeks of morning stroke camp before school starts.

classes.title: Junior Hoops
classes.text: Dribbling, passing, shooting form and lots of small-sided games. Every player gets a Brightwater training jersey.

classes.title: Teen Skills & Scrimmage
classes.text: Position drills for the first half, coached scrimmage for the second.

classes.title: Adult Pickup League
classes.text: Friday night games with a referee and rotating teams. Sign up alone or with friends; we balance the teams.
classes.bring: Sneakers, a light and a dark shirt.

classes.title: Tennis Starter for Adults
classes.text: Grip, forehand, backhand, serve and a first rally. Rackets are on loan if you don't have one.

classes.title: Junior Tennis Academy
classes.text: Twice-weekly training for juniors who can already rally: footwork, point play and match strategy.

classes.title: Cardio Tennis
classes.text: A high-energy hour of drills and games to music.

classes.title: Intro to Bouldering
classes.text: Four evenings to learn footwork, falling safely and reading problems. Shoes and chalk included.
classes.bring: Comfortable clothes you can stretch in.

classes.title: Youth Climbing Team
classes.text: Training for young climbers who want to push grades and try their first competitions.

classes.title: Lead Climbing Course
classes.text: Clipping, falling, belaying a leader and rope management. You need to be a confident top-rope climber.

classes.title: Morning Flow
classes.text: Wake up with a steady vinyasa flow. Suitable for all levels, with options for every pose.
classes.bring: Mat if you have one (we have spares).

classes.title: Yoga for Athletes
classes.text: Mobility, hip and shoulder work and recovery for runners, swimmers and climbers.
classes.bring: Mat, a strap if you have one.

classes.title: Prenatal Yoga
classes.cancelReason: The instructor is on leave this season. Everyone was refunded in full.
classes.text: Gentle yoga for expecting parents.

classes.title: Little Dragons Karate
classes.text: Focus, balance and respect through games and basic karate. Children earn stripes on their white belt as they learn.
classes.bring: Comfortable clothes, bare feet on the mat.

classes.title: Judo Fundamentals
classes.text: Breakfalls, grips, throws and pins, taught safely from the ground up. Gis available to borrow.
classes.bring: Gi or long sleeves and sweatpants.

classes.title: Self-Defense Workshop
classes.text: Two practical Saturday afternoons: awareness, voice, breaking grips and getting away.

classes.title: Hip-Hop for Teens
classes.text: Grooves, footwork and a new routine every few weeks. No experience needed.

classes.title: Ballet Basics
classes.text: Posture, positions and simple jumps, ending with a small show for parents.
classes.bring: Leotard or comfortable clothes, ballet shoes.

classes.title: Salsa Nights
classes.text: Learn the basics and a few turns. Come alone or with a partner; we rotate.

classes.title: Tumble Tots
classes.text: Rolling, balancing, jumping and climbing for the youngest. A parent joins for the first two sessions.

classes.title: Gymnastics Club
classes.text: Floor, beam, bars and vault basics, with safe landings first.
classes.bring: Leotard or fitted clothes, hair tied back.

classes.title: Parkour Basics
classes.text: Vaults, precision jumps and rolls on soft obstacles.

classes.title: Summer Gym Camp
classes.text: Two weeks of morning gymnastics fun.

blocks.title: Find your sport. Keep moving.
blocks.text: Eight sports, small classes and coaches who know your name. Book a class in a minute, or drop in with a day pass.
blocks.label: Browse classes

blocks.title: Eight sports under one roof
blocks.text: From the teaching pool to the climbing hall, every space is built for learning.

items.title: Book a class
items.text: Pick a class, choose who it's for and pay online or at the front desk.
items.label: See the schedule

items.title: Drop in
items.text: A day pass opens the pools, courts and climbing hall for a day. No account needed.
items.label: Buy a day pass

items.title: Join free
items.text: Members earn points on every dollar and every session, and save up to 10% per class.
items.label: Sign up

blocks.title: Points that pay you back
blocks.text: Sign up free. Earn points on every class and every session you attend, climb from Bronze to Diamond and spend points on your next class.
blocks.label: Sign up free

blocks.title: Just want to swim or climb today?
blocks.text: One price for open swim, the climbing hall, open courts and the fitness floor. Show your code at the front desk.
blocks.label: Buy a day pass

blocks.title: Sports at Brightwater
blocks.text: Swimming, basketball, tennis, climbing, yoga, martial arts, dance and gymnastics. Find the right level and age group for everyone in the family.

blocks.title: Try a day pass first
blocks.text: Look around, try the climbing hall or the pool, and talk to a coach at the front desk.
blocks.label: Buy a day pass

blocks.title: Find a class
blocks.text: Every class runs for a set number of sessions at one price. Seats are limited, so book early. Full classes keep a waitlist and offer free seats in order.

items.title: Do I need an account?
items.text: Yes, class registration needs a free member account so we can keep your receipts, family members and points together. Day passes don't need one.

items.title: Can I book for my child?
items.text: Yes. Add your children as family members in the member area, then choose them when you register. We check the age for each class.

items.title: What happens if a class is full?
items.text: Join the waitlist. When a seat opens, the first person on the list gets an offer and 24 hours to pay. If they don't, the next person gets it.

items.title: What is the refund policy?
items.text: Cancel more than 48 hours before the first session for a full refund, or between 48 and 24 hours before for 50%. After that, ask the front desk.

blocks.title: Instructors
blocks.text: Certified, first-aid trained and genuinely kind. Most of our coaches have taught at Brightwater for years.

blocks.title: Photos, videos and documents
blocks.text: See the center, watch a short tour, and download the program guide and forms.

blocks.title: A community sports center
blocks.text: Brightwater opened in 2012 on the old lakeside warehouse site. Today it's where Marlow Heights learns to swim, plays on Friday nights and climbs on rainy Sundays.

blocks.title: Built for learning
blocks.text:
A 25 m lap pool and a warm teaching pool, two hardwood courts, four tennis courts, a climbing hall, two studios, a dojo, a gym hall and a fitness floor.

Everything is step-free, with family changing rooms on every level.
blocks.label: See the sports

items.title: Small groups
items.text: Every class has a seat limit we keep, even when it is popular.

items.title: Qualified coaches
items.text: Certified instructors, first-aid trained, with background checks.

items.title: Clear prices
items.text: One price per class. Members save more and earn points.

items.title: Fair refunds
items.text: Simple cancellation rules, and a real person when life happens.

blocks.title: A member parent
blocks.text: My daughter started in Splash at four. Now she's on the youth climbing team and teaches me knots.

blocks.title: Come and look around
blocks.text: Ask at the front desk for a tour. Opening hours are on the Contact page.
blocks.label: Contact and hours

blocks.title: Day pass
blocks.text: One day of open swim, open courts, the climbing hall and the fitness floor. No account needed: just your name, email and phone.

blocks.title: Buy a day pass
blocks.text: Show the code at the front desk. If you sign up later with the same email, your visits stay on your account.

items.title: Included
items.text:
Open swim during public lanes
Open courts when free
Climbing hall with shoe loan
Fitness floor and lockers

items.title: Not included
items.text:
Classes and courses
Private lessons
Court bookings for groups
Towel hire

blocks.title: Sign up
blocks.text: Create your account to register for classes, add your family, keep receipts in one place and earn points from day one.

blocks.title: Create your account
blocks.text: Already bought a day pass? Use the same email and we'll keep your visit history.

blocks.title: Climb the tiers
blocks.text: Your tier is based on lifetime points, so it never goes down. Spend points any time: they come off your next class.

blocks.title: Talk to the front desk
blocks.text: Questions about classes, membership or a refund? Send a message, call or come by.

blocks.title: Send us a message
blocks.text: Lost and found is at the front desk for 30 days. Ask any staff member.
